descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 30 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
One rule. 11,500 puzzles. A board of real tiles right in front of you.
blackflip is a calm, clever puzzle game. Every puzzle is a board of dark and light tiles. Draw one path across it, press FLIP, and every tile under your path turns over. If each row ends up in a single color, the puzzle is solved. That is the whole rule, and it goes a long way: the first levels take seconds, later ones will keep you thinking.
• A board you can touch: the puzzle lies on a desk in front of you. Draw your path with a fingertip or point at it, then hit the big FLIP button and watch the tiles jump and turn.
• Hands or controllers: play with hand tracking or with your Touch controllers.
• Your room or ours: play in a quiet dark room with tiles drifting by, or switch on Mixed Reality and solve puzzles in your own room.
• 11,500 puzzles made by players, from quick small boards to tricky large ones.
• Three stars per puzzle: solve it, find the shortest path, and get it right on the first try.
• Stuck? Spend coins you earned to see the solution.
• Puzzle Creator: paint your own puzzle, prove that it can be solved, and publish it for everyone.
• Beat the record: find a shorter path for a community puzzle than anyone before you.
• See how others did: how many players solved a puzzle, and the best time.
• No ads, no account. Just you and the puzzles.
Easy to learn in a minute, hard to put down.
